coffee-yellow.note: Buy Me a Coffee's brand yellow, on its button only: the one exception to the One Yellow Rule.

display.purpose: The engraved BPM only; fitted between the step discs up to 8rem. Falls back to plain numerals at up to 5rem under no-engraved.

display-signature.purpose: Stacked engraved metre opening the figure's caption, chalk; the metre control's value between its 44px − and + discs.

headline.purpose: Italian tempo marking above the metronome mark; never wraps.

title-numeral.purpose: Numerals on the beat-pattern figure, up to 8 beats.

label-score.purpose: Italian markings engraved on the tempo ruler.

body.purpose: Base text; notes cap at 60ch. Metronome Sans TC (bundled variable Noto Sans TC 2.004 subset, wght 400-700, ~54 KB, interface characters only) leads --sans for Chinese and Latin; ± is left out so it falls to the system face; U+2212 (minus) is in it. English takes proportional quotes and ellipsis via :lang(en) { font-variant-east-asian: proportional-width }. Weights in use: 400, 500, 600, 650, 700.

label.purpose: Legend row labels and secondary buttons.

label-small.purpose: Accent hint beside the caption's metre (balanced wrapping; Chinese breaks only at punctuation and arrows), language switch (at 650), the trainer's step rule, trainer field labels, stacked secondary labels in a transport 348px wide or less.

title-numeral-crowded.purpose: Beat numerals sitting on their ictus in bars of more than 8 beats.

display-signature-fallback.purpose: Time signature as plain digits when the engraved face is unavailable (no-engraved), 1.25rem at line-height 1.

label-note.purpose: Trainer note paragraph, Install text-button label.

title-wordmark.purpose: The app name beside the icon, in the score voice: Old Standard TT for Latin, Metronome Wordmark (Noto Serif TC Bold subset holding only 節拍器, unicode-range limited) for the Chinese.

headline-tempo-change.purpose: "accel." or "rit." in italic in place of the marking while the speed trainer heads for its target. Metronome Score Italic: Old Standard TT Italic 400 subset holding only those letters (unicode-range limited, built by scripts/build-fonts.py --italic). Followed by a 0.75em sans arrow, a 1.4em engraved mini metronome mark and the step rule in label-small.

label-coffee.purpose: The support button's "Buy me a coffee", in the Cookie lettering Buy Me a Coffee's buttons use (subset Metronome Coffee).

shadows.name: start-lift
shadows.purpose: The Start/Stop button only; presses to 0 2px 8px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.2).

shadows.name: floating-toast
shadows.purpose: Status toast over the header row (under the language switch from 900px), never over the figure or Start.

motion.name: state
motion.purpose: Background, border and colour changes on controls; beat release; struck ictus bar widening (scaleX 1.5); trainer switch knob and fill.

motion.name: press
motion.purpose: Press scale on Start (0.97), secondary (0.97) and step (0.94) buttons.

motion.name: beat-scale
motion.purpose: Beat numeral scale release; the strike itself lands with 0s.

motion.name: numeral-swap
motion.purpose: On release a beat numeral's colour swaps 55ms into the fill's 160ms release, so it never matches its fill; the strike itself lands with no delay.

motion.name: sub-tick
motion.purpose: Subdivision tick brightens to full and fades back to 35%.

motion.name: ripple
motion.purpose: One expanding ring per strike (0.5 to 1.5, accent to 1.9); none for muted beats or under reduced motion.

motion.name: baton-velocity
motion.purpose: Baton travel along each segment: fastest into the ictus, slowest at the rebound. Reduced motion places it on the ictus instead.

motion.name: tap-pulse
motion.purpose: Tap button scales 0.94 to 1 on each tap.

breakpoints.name: tiny
breakpoints.purpose: max-width: header tightens (wordmark 1rem, gaps 8px/4px), legend rows stack, tempo step discs 46px, trainer fields single column.

breakpoints.name: transport-narrow
breakpoints.purpose: @container (the transport) max-width: secondary buttons stack icon over label at 64px with a 20px radius.

breakpoints.name: wide
breakpoints.purpose: min-width: 32px gutters, 760px stage, two-column legend panel (rows left, trainer right over the first three rows), toast under the language switch.

breakpoints.name: short
breakpoints.purpose: max-height: header 52px, stage reserve 348px, figure min 288px, gap 8px, figure margin-top 4px, BPM capped at 72px, ruler drops its markings (padding 0), transport margin 0. Default stage: reserve 476px, figure min 320px.

breakpoints.name: landscape
breakpoints.purpose: Two columns 24px apart: the figure spans every row on the left; tempo, ruler and transport grouped and centred on the right (rows 1fr auto auto auto 1fr).

themes.dark: Default; slate tokens (slate, chalk, slate-rule, chalk-path). Baton yellow with slate ring; focus yellow. Accent beat rests as a 3px yellow ring with a yellow numeral on the ground and strikes solid yellow with a chalk ring and slate numeral.
themes.light: prefers-color-scheme: light; paper/navy tokens. Baton yellow with a navy ring; yellow shapes take a navy edge; focus navy. Accent beat rests as the highlighter disc (yellow, 2px navy edge) and strikes navy with a yellow ring.
themes.forcedColors: Pen strokes, arrowheads and ticks fill CanvasText; ictus bars stroke CanvasText; baton and ripples Highlight; accent beat CanvasText fill; trainer target outline CanvasText; struck beat, selected segment, Trainer-on, switch-on (HighlightText knob) and current language Highlight fills; control borders and the off switch's knob ButtonText; Start shadow replaced by a 2px ButtonText border.
themes.reducedMotion: Transitions off; no beat scale and no ictus bar widening; baton placed on each ictus without travel; no ripple; held strike fill remains.
themes.noEngraved: When Metronome Engraved fails to load: note and '=' hidden (in the metronome mark and the tempo change), BPM plain numerals up to 5rem at line-height 1, time signature in display-signature-fallback (1.25rem, line-height 1), subdivision tuplet 3 as a plain Old Standard digit.

pen.profile: smoothstep from u=0.3 to the ictus
pen.fill: chalk-path / navy-path, one path, uniform winding

arrowhead.placement: one per stroke on the fall, first clear spot from the rebound top; omitted where none is clear and in bars of 9+ beats

components.name: Start Button
components.description: The single primary action: yellow pill, the only lifted object on the board.
components.css: :host{--ground:#172036;--ground-2:#1d2742;--ink:#eceff6;--ink-2:#b4bdd2;--ink-3:#8792ad;--rule:#33405f;--path:rgb(236 239 246 / 0.6);--yellow:#fccf3f;--on-yellow:#172036;--focus:#fccf3f;--score:'Old Standard TT','Iowan Old Style','Palatino Linotype',Palatino,Georgia,serif;--engraved:'Metronome Engraved','Old Standard TT',Georgia,serif;--sans:'Metronome Sans TC',system-ui,-apple-system,'Segoe UI','PingFang TC','Noto Sans TC',sans-serif} .ds-start{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:10px;min-width:148px;height:64px;padding:0 28px;border:0;border-radius:999px;background:var(--yellow);color:var(--on-yellow);font:700 1.125rem/1 var(--sans);box-shadow:0 6px 18px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.22);cursor:pointer;transition:scale 100ms ease-out,box-shadow 160ms ease-out}.ds-start svg{width:24px;height:24px;fill:currentColor}.ds-start:active{scale:.97;box-shadow:0 2px 8px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.2)}.ds-start:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--focus);outline-offset:3px}

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Tap and Trainer flanking Start: ruled full pill, line icon; stacks into a 20px-radius panel when the transport is 348px wide or less.
components.css: :host{--ground:#172036;--ground-2:#1d2742;--ink:#eceff6;--ink-2:#b4bdd2;--ink-3:#8792ad;--rule:#33405f;--path:rgb(236 239 246 / 0.6);--yellow:#fccf3f;--on-yellow:#172036;--focus:#fccf3f;--score:'Old Standard TT','Iowan Old Style','Palatino Linotype',Palatino,Georgia,serif;--engraved:'Metronome Engraved','Old Standard TT',Georgia,serif;--sans:'Metronome Sans TC',system-ui,-apple-system,'Segoe UI','PingFang TC','Noto Sans TC',sans-serif} .ds-secondary{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:6px;min-width:92px;height:52px;padding:0 14px;border:1.5px solid var(--rule);border-radius:999px;background:none;color:var(--ink);font:600 .9375rem/1 var(--sans);cursor:pointer;transition:background-color 160ms ease-out,border-color 160ms ease-out,scale 100ms ease-out}.ds-secondary svg{width:20px;height:20px;fill:none;stroke:currentColor;stroke-width:2;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round}.ds-secondary:hover{background:var(--ground-2)}.ds-secondary:active{scale:.97}.ds-secondary:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--focus);outline-offset:3px}.ds-secondary[aria-pressed=true]{border-color:var(--yellow);background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--yellow) 18%,var(--ground))}@container (max-width:348px){.ds-secondary{flex-direction:column;gap:2px;height:64px;padding:0 10px;border-radius:20px;font-size:.8125rem}}

components.name: Step Disc
components.description: The − and + tempo steps (52px) and metre steps (44px, in the caption): ruled circle, hold to repeat.

components.name: Beat Numerals
components.description: Accent controls on the beat-pattern figure: accent ring with yellow numeral (dark), normal ring, dashed mute, held struck fill; a struck accent turns solid yellow.
components.css: :host{--ground:#172036;--ground-2:#1d2742;--ink:#eceff6;--ink-2:#b4bdd2;--ink-3:#8792ad;--rule:#33405f;--path:rgb(236 239 246 / 0.6);--yellow:#fccf3f;--on-yellow:#172036;--focus:#fccf3f;--score:'Old Standard TT','Iowan Old Style','Palatino Linotype',Palatino,Georgia,serif;--engraved:'Metronome Engraved','Old Standard TT',Georgia,serif;--sans:'Metronome Sans TC',system-ui,-apple-system,'Segoe UI','PingFang TC','Noto Sans TC',sans-serif} .ds-beats{display:flex;gap:16px;padding:16px;background:var(--ground)}.ds-beat{display:grid;place-items:center;width:44px;height:44px;border:2px solid var(--path);border-radius:50%;background:var(--ground);color:var(--ink);font:700 1.25rem/1 var(--score);font-variant-numeric:lining-nums;cursor:pointer;transition:scale 140ms ease-out,background-color 160ms ease-out,border-color 160ms ease-out,color 0s 55ms}.ds-beat:hover{border-color:var(--ink)}.ds-beat:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--focus);outline-offset:3px}.ds-accent{border-width:3px;border-color:var(--yellow);background:var(--ground);color:var(--yellow)}.ds-mute{border-style:dashed;color:var(--ink-3)}.ds-active{scale:1.14;border-color:var(--ink);background:var(--ink);color:var(--ground);transition-duration:0s;transition-delay:0s}.ds-accent.ds-active{border-color:var(--ink);background:var(--yellow);color:var(--on-yellow)}

components.name: Tempo Mark

components.html: Allegro=120

components.name: Figure Caption
components.description: The figure's caption is the metre control: "− 4/4 +", 44px step discs either side of the engraved time signature. How the numerals work is told once, in a hint bubble.

components.css: :host{--ground:#172036;--ground-2:#1d2742;--ink:#eceff6;--ink-2:#b4bdd2;--ink-3:#8792ad;--rule:#33405f;--path:rgb(236 239 246 / 0.6);--yellow:#fccf3f;--on-yellow:#172036;--focus:#fccf3f;--score:'Old Standard TT','Iowan Old Style','Palatino Linotype',Palatino,Georgia,serif;--engraved:'Metronome Engraved','Old Standard TT',Georgia,serif;--sans:'Metronome Sans TC',system-ui,-apple-system,'Segoe UI','PingFang TC','Noto Sans TC',sans-serif} .ds-switch{position:relative;width:52px;height:32px;padding:0;border:1.5px solid var(--rule);border-radius:999px;background:var(--ground);cursor:pointer;transition:background-color 160ms ease-out,border-color 160ms ease-out}.ds-switch::before{content:'';position:absolute;inset:-7.5px -1.5px}.ds-switch::after{content:'';position:absolute;top:50%;left:4px;width:21px;height:21px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--ink-3);translate:0 -50%;transition:translate 160ms ease-out,background-color 160ms ease-out}.ds-switch[aria-checked=true]{border-color:var(--ink);background:var(--ink)}.ds-switch[aria-checked=true]::after{background:var(--ground);translate:20px -50%}.ds-switch:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--focus);outline-offset:3px}

components.name: Hint Bubble
components.description: Said once, beside the control it explains, the first time it matters: the toast's chalk surface with a pointer; takes no touch and ends at the next touch or key, remembered.
components.html: 點數字切換：重音 → 一般 → 靜音
components.css: :host{--ground:#172036;--ground-2:#1d2742;--ink:#eceff6;--ink-2:#b4bdd2;--ink-3:#8792ad;--rule:#33405f;--path:rgb(236 239 246 / 0.6);--yellow:#fccf3f;--on-yellow:#172036;--focus:#fccf3f;--score:'Old Standard TT','Iowan Old Style','Palatino Linotype',Palatino,Georgia,serif;--engraved:'Metronome Engraved','Old Standard TT',Georgia,serif;--sans:'Metronome Sans TC',system-ui,-apple-system,'Segoe UI','PingFang TC','Noto Sans TC',sans-serif} .ds-bubble{position:relative;display:inline-block;margin-top:12px;max-width:260px;padding:8px 12px;border-radius:14px;background:var(--ink);color:var(--ground);box-shadow:0 10px 30px rgb(0 0 0 / .3);font:400 .875rem/1.4 var(--sans);text-wrap:balance;word-break:keep-all}.ds-bubble::before{content:'';position:absolute;top:-6px;left:calc(50% - 6px);width:12px;height:12px;background:inherit;rotate:45deg}

narrative.overview:
The bar is drawn the way a conductor draws it in a textbook: a beat-pattern figure (downbeat falling straight, the upbeat rising, side beats on the plane of beating) traced by a single yellow baton point that strikes each ictus on the click. The world is a music-room chalkboard: icon-navy slate owns the surface, strokes and numerals are chalk, and one yellow marks the baton and the accents. In light mode the same drawing becomes a conducting-textbook page: navy ink on cool paper, with yellow kept as a highlighter fill that always carries an ink edge.

Music notation is the type voice wherever the app speaks musically. The tempo is set as a score prints it, an Italian marking over an engraved metronome mark ("Allegro / ♩ = 120"); the meter is a real stacked time signature, captioning the figure between its own − and +; a tempo change from the speed trainer is written as a score writes one ("accel. → ♩ = 160"), in the score's italic; the app's own name is set in the score voice; the tempo slider is an engraved metronome scale whose thumb is the pendulum's sliding weight. Everything operational (labels, buttons, settings) is a quiet sans, bundled so every device sets it the same way, so the notation reads as the content and the chrome recedes.

Density is low and glance-first: the figure takes the upper half of the screen, the tempo mark sits at arm's-length size between large − and + discs, and Start is the one filled object in the transport. Settings sit beneath as a diagram's legend on a slightly raised slate and close the page; the instrument explains itself, not small print around it. Motion exists only to show time: the baton's travel, a held strike state, one ripple per beat. Nothing flashes. The figure itself is drawn as a pen draws it, light through each rebound and pressing into each ictus, with one arrowhead on each fall and a short printed bar where the baton strikes.
keyCharacteristics: Navy slate (dark) or cool paper (light) surface, chalk/ink strokes, a single yellow.
The beat-pattern figure is the hero and the accent control at once.
Engraved Bravura-derived numerals and Old Standard TT (with its italic for tempo changes) for everything musical and for the wordmark; Metronome Sans TC (bundled Noto Sans TC) for chrome.
Pen-weighted strokes, arrowheads and ictus bars hold their on-screen size at every figure size.
Round and pill forms throughout; flat surfaces with one soft lift under Start.
Strike states are held, not flashed; reduced motion keeps the information and drops the travel.

rules.name: The One Yellow Rule
rules.body: Yellow is the only hue. It marks the baton, accents and the single primary action; it never decorates, never tints a surface beyond the 18% pressed-toggle mix, and never appears as text on a light ground.

rules.name: The Ink-Edged Highlighter Rule
rules.body: On paper, yellow is a fill that always carries a navy edge (3px on the ruler weight, 2px on resting accent beats, a navy ring on the baton) or navy text inside it. Yellow alone never stands as a shape on the light ground.

rules.name: The Brightest Strike Rule
rules.body: A struck beat is the largest change on the board. On slate, yellow to chalk is only 1.3:1, so an accent rests as a 3px yellow ring around a yellow numeral on the ground and strikes solid yellow with a chalk ring and slate numeral (10.9:1); on paper it rests yellow and strikes navy. Crowded accents thin their edge to max(1.5px, edge − 1px).

rules.name: The Rule Is Not State Rule
rules.body: The rule colours (1.5:1 against their grounds) only separate and outline; no state is ever carried by a rule-coloured border alone. Selection and strike are fills (chalk/ink or yellow), muting is a dashed ring.

rules.name: The Notation Voice Rule
rules.body: Any musical quantity (tempo, meter, beat number, tuplet number, tempo marking, tempo change) and the app's wordmark are set in the engraved face or the score serif; any instruction or setting name is set in the sans. Never swap them.

rules.name: The Proportional English Rule
rules.body: The interface face's quotes and ellipsis are full-width, for Chinese; English text takes their proportional forms through `:lang(en) { font-variant-east-asian: proportional-width }`. Every English run carries `lang="en"`.

rules.name: The Engraved Fallback Rule
rules.body: If the engraved face fails to load (detected through `document.fonts.load`, e.g. iOS Lockdown Mode), the root takes a `no-engraved` class: the note and "=" are hidden, the BPM drops to plain numerals at up to 5rem with line-height 1, the time signature takes its fallback size, and the subdivision icons' tuplet 3 becomes a plain Old Standard digit. The tight engraved metrics are never applied to a substitute face.

rules.name: The One Lifted Object Rule
rules.body: Only the primary action casts a shadow on the board; everything else is drawn on it.

rules.name: The Pen Rule
rules.body: The pattern is drawn, not stroked: light on the rebound, heavy into the ictus, heaviest into the downbeat, at fixed screen widths. Never draw it as a uniform line.

rules.name: The Clear Arrow Rule
rules.body: An arrowhead appears only where it is clear of every numeral, mark, tick, the baton and the other strokes; where nothing is clear, the stroke goes without. Better no arrow than one hidden or misread.

dos: **Do** draw anything musical in notation: engraved numerals for tempo and meter, Old Standard TT for markings, beat numbers and the wordmark, drawn SVG notes with the engraved tuplet 3 for rhythmic values.
**Do** keep Baton Yellow (#fccf3f) for the baton, accents and the single primary action, and give it a navy edge on paper.

**Do** show beat state with held fills (chalk/ink for struck; for accent a yellow ring that strikes solid yellow on slate, a highlighter disc that strikes navy on paper; dashed ring for mute), landing at once and releasing with a 140-160ms ease-out, the numeral's colour swapping 55ms into the release.

**Do** keep touch targets at 44px or larger (52px tempo discs, 44px metre discs, toast buttons, switch, language links and sliders, 64px Start) and let the figure, tempo mark and Start share the first viewport at every stage size, by its reserve and figure minimum.
**Do** give every state a fill or border that survives forced colours, and keep selected states as fills distinct from the focus outline.
**Do** draw the pattern with pen weight (1.5px rebound, 3.4px ictus, 4.8px downbeat) and printed 16px ictus bars, sized in screen px.
**Do** degrade to plain numerals when the engraved face is unavailable rather than squeezing a fallback into engraved metrics.
**Do** keep small text around the instrument minimal; small text that teaches retires once it has been used, and keyboard shortcuts live in aria-keyshortcuts and tooltips, not on the page.

**Do** add any new interface character to the Metronome Sans TC subset (scripts/build-fonts.py), any new score-voice Chinese to Metronome Wordmark, and any new tempo-change letters to Metronome Score Italic, rather than letting it fall through to a system face.
donts: **Don't** flash, pulse or loop decoration on the beat; motion only shows the baton's travel and one ripple per strike, and none of it may delay the click.
**Don't** introduce a second accent hue or tint surfaces with yellow.
**Don't** add shadows to anything except Start and the toast.
**Don't** set a toast over the figure or Start; it belongs over the header row, or under the language switch on wide screens.
**Don't** fall back to the big-number-and-dot-row metronome layout; the beat pattern is the beat display.
**Don't** use Unicode music symbols (♩ ♫ ♬) as UI text; they render inconsistently, so notes are engraved glyphs or drawn SVG.
**Don't** carry state with a rule-coloured border alone.
